title: 忘却の書庫と、迷子の電子音
author: 神楽坂 探

en.title: The Library of Oblivion and the Lost Electronic Signal
en.premise: In an underground library deep within the city, where thousands of books lie dormant, a librarian is discovered dead in a locked room. The only things left at the scene are the inexplicable scent of ancient paper and an unidentified electronic signal. The detective accompanying us asserts that the key to unraveling this "logical contradiction" lies within a lost artificial intelligence, severed from the city. In the end, will the physical traces or the digital echoes tell the truth?

zh.title: 忘却之书库与迷失的电子音
zh.premise: 在城市深处，一座沉睡着数千卷书籍的地下图书馆内，一名图书管理员被发现死于密室之中。现场只留下了难以解释的陈旧纸张气味，以及来源不明的电子信号。随行的侦探断言，解开这一“逻辑矛盾”的关键，在于一个与城市隔绝的迷失人工智能。究竟是物理痕迹，还是数字残响，才能诉说真相？
